description: A dotnet tool for enhancing docfx behaviour and template/theme.
releaseNotes:
- **Fixed:** Normalize new lines inside of parent elements, which contain `` blocks to prevent Yaml multi-line problems (`.yml` generated by `docfx`). This way text surrounding code blocks will not break Yaml due to inconsistent indentation. Previous workaround, i.e. using `
` tags as new lines is no longer required, so also now in the template `main.js` we no longer need to replace back `
` tags (additional performance gain).
